simple.meaning: דַּכָּא (dakkâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “crushed (literally powder, or figuratively, contrite).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דַּכָּא (H1793) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 34:19, with occurrences in Psalms, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דַּכָּא (H1793) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דַּכָּא (H1793) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דַּכָּא (dakkâʼ) / H1793 is traced through Psalms 34:19, Psalms 90:3, Isaiah 57:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1793. dakka ' I. דַּכָּא adjective contrite (crushed) — דַּכָּא Isa 57:15 ; דַּכְּאֵי Psa 34:19 — contrite Isa 57:15 (|| שְׁפַלרֿוּחַ ); ׳ד רוּחַ Psa 34:19 (|| נִשְׁבְּרֵילֵֿב ). II. דַּכָּא noun [masculine] dust (as pulverized), עַדדַּֿכָּא אֱנוֺשׁ תָּשֵׁב Psa 90:3 (on form compare Ba NB 143 ).
